description: This file defines the abstract base class 'Template' for Twig's template system, including methods for rendering, block management, and parent/child template interactions.

classes.name: Twig	emplate
classes.description: Abstract base class for compiled Twig templates, providing rendering, block, and parent template management functionalities.

methods.name: getTemplateName
methods.description: Returns the template's name.

methods.name: getDebugInfo
methods.description: Provides debug information about the template.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Returns information about the original source code of the template.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Retrieves the parent template if defined.

methods.name: doGetParent
methods.description: Internal method to determine the parent template.

methods.name: isTraitable
methods.description: Indicates whether the template can be extended.

methods.name: displayParentBlock
methods.description: Displays a block from the parent template.

methods.name: displayBlock
methods.description: Displays a specific block in the template.

methods.name: renderParentBlock
methods.description: Renders a parent block's content as a string.

methods.name: renderBlock
methods.description: Renders a block as a string.

methods.name: hasBlock
methods.description: Checks if a block exists in the current context.

methods.name: getBlockNames
methods.description: Retrieves all block names available in the template.

methods.name: loadTemplate
methods.description: Loads and resolves a template instance.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Returns the template instance itself.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Returns all blocks defined in the template.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the rendered template with the given context.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Returns the rendered template as a string.

methods.name: yield
methods.description: Generator that yields parts of the template rendering.

methods.name: yieldBlock
methods.description: Generator that yields content of a specific block.

methods.name: yieldParentBlock
methods.description: Generator that yields a parent block's content.

methods.name: hasMacro
methods.description: Checks if a macro is defined.

methods.name: getTemplateForMacro
methods.description: Finds the template that defines a macro.

methods.name: doDisplay
methods.description: Internal method to display the template, to be implemented by subclasses.
